hints.title: Symmetric Pairing
hints.text: Process the row of houses symmetrically from the two ends toward the middle in pairs.

hints.title: Equidistant Constraints
hints.text: Each step assigns colors to house i and house n - 1 - i while ensuring they are distinct.

hints.title: Adjacency State Tracking
hints.text: Maintain the colors assigned to the immediate predecessors to respect adjacency constraints.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Transitions across 9 symmetric color pairs over n / 2 steps with constant state.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Left to right enumeration cannot easily enforce equidistant symmetry without complex state.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Rolling DP array uses constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulates symmetric inward pairing DP state with adjacency and equality constraints.
